verdict.rationale: Wrike ships AI features (Copilot, AI Essentials, agents), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Customer-managed encryption keys are an adjacent access control, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
